requirement: Validate an update-dosage command: the dosage ID and antibiotic ID must not be empty, the route must be a defined enum member, the dose text must not be empty or whitespace, and the optional CrCl range must satisfy the shared range rules when it is supplied.

preconditions.text: Validation runs on an in-memory command without database access
The CrCl range is omitted, so the nested range validator is skipped
A CrCl range is supplied and must satisfy the min/max rule

inputs.text: Oral standard dose of 500 mg every 8 hours with version-7 IDs
Intravenous standard dose of 1 g every 8 hours with version-7 IDs
CrCl range with min equal to max (30 mL/min)
Route of administration 999 (outside every defined member)
CrCl range with min 60 greater than max 15

returns.text: Single validation error reported on Id, AntibioticId, RouteOfAdministration, Dose, or Crcl

exception_text: No unhandled exception; invalid input is reported as validation errors
